author: (Er. Marcus, 1957)

note.en: A tiny aeolid nudibranch of about 4.5 mm known here from one specimen taken at 9 m west of the Punta Mona islet in 2001.
note.es: Un nudibranquio eólido diminuto de unos 4,5 mm conocido aquí por un ejemplar tomado a 9 m al oeste del islote de Punta Mona en 2001.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
